title: MV Searching a plugin similar to one from other engine

posts.author: SexPistols
posts.body: Hello, I would like to know if there is some plugin with the function to easily change the battle commands for each class, the plugin I was thinking would be really useful is YEA-BattleCommandList, but I believe it's only available for RPG Maker VX Ace, it allows you to right from the notetag of the class modify its entire battle command list ( Attack, skills, guard, etc. )

posts.author: SexPistols
posts.body: Nevermind, VE - CommandReplace worked fine with what I wanted to do
